meta.title: UnLitigate — Unlitigate your disputes
meta.description: Court is not the only way to resolve a dispute. Mediation is a guided conversation where both sides work toward an agreement they choose. Pilot starting in Bhubaneswar and Pune.

hero.heading: Unlitigate your disputes.
hero.body: Court is not the only way to resolve a dispute. Mediation is a guided conversation where both sides work toward an agreement they choose.

court.heading: Court
court.body: Formal proceedings. A judge decides the outcome. Timelines can be long.

mediation.heading: Mediation
mediation.body: A guided conversation. Both sides work toward an agreement they choose.

paths.heading: Two paths, side by side

rows.label: Time
rows.court: Can take a long time, depending on the court and the case.
rows.mediation: Often shorter, but it depends on both sides.

rows.label: Cost
rows.court: Court and lawyer costs can add up over time.
rows.mediation: Usually lower, and costs are often shared.

rows.label: Control
rows.mediation: You and the other side decide together.

paths.footnote: Not every dispute suits mediation, and an agreement is never guaranteed.

stories.heading: Why we started
stories.subheading: We don't have client stories yet. Here are ours.

items.name: Anushka Jena
items.quote: Ma'am, you'll have to come to court every day. Are you sure?
items.body: Somewhere in India, someone is about to drop their case. Not because they were wrong. Because fighting costs money, and years of peace. UnLitigate your disputes and choose your agency.

items.name: Madhur
items.quote: A dispute should not swallow a whole year of someone's life.
items.body: Watching people wait — and then give up — is what made this feel urgent. Mediation is a way to stay in the room without giving up the outcome.

items.name: Prakhar
items.quote: People deserve a first step that does not feel like a fight.
items.body: I joined after the project began because the idea was simple and serious: explain the option clearly, then help people take it.

bench.heading: Unlitigate your disputes.
bench.body: Choosing mediation is not giving up. It is taking control of how your dispute ends.
